ev_0005.summary: Circle centered at O (185.58,222.22), radius 157.27 px, verified full 360 deg. Labeled points A, B, C, D lie on the circle. DC is a diameter through O (midpoint of D and C is about (185.46,222.30), matching O). Solid chords AB, AC, BC and diameter DC are present. Line AB crosses DC at unlabeled point_02 (156.65,172.22); I checked this against both lines and it lies on both segments. No right-angle mark was verified (detect_right_angle_marker returned 0 markers), so none is submitted.
